messages:
Sam: Heads-up — tonight 23:00 UTC we're doing a multipath NIC firmware update + interconnect path reshuffle in apac-west2. Rolling cordon + reboot of cohorts, target window 3h. Expect ~10% GPU capacity reduction for APAC during each cohort's reboot (30–60m). Use reserved/dedicated pools for critical jobs.

Liam: Start time exact? which pools are impacted?

Sam: Start 2025-09-14 23:00 UTC. Impacted pools: apac-west2-gpu-high, apac-west2-gpu-low, apac-west2-burst. Cohorts are ~12 nodes each, we'll cordon one cohort at a time and run a canary.

Anya: Canary + rollback plan?

Sam: Canary on cohort-01 at t0 for 15m. Acceptance: kv-cache warmup within expected baseline and p99 < 120ms. If canary fails we abort and uncordon cohort-01; will not proceed to other cohorts. Rollback is immediate uncordon + drain-retry next maintenance window.

Jamie: Any automated backfill/backpressure changes during the window?

Sam: We'll open scheduler backfill for spot pools to mitigate queued jobs. That can increase cost ~12–20% temporarily. We'll also lower batch sizes for latency-critical routes. DevEx please notify high-throughput customers to avoid starting very long jobs during the window.

DevEx: On it — will post banner + email to tenants with >200 TPS and add a note to customer-status.

Oncall-Mike: I'll monitor queue backlog and set an alert: queued_tasks > 200 for >10m triggers paging.

InfraBot: action: cohort-01 canary deployment scheduled at 2025-09-14T23:05Z (dry-run).

Liam: What verification steps for multipath?

Sam: Run these checks after reboot: `netdiag --multipath-check`, `nvlink-health --summary`, and ensure `rx_drop` metrics < 0.5%. Primary observed metrics:
- p99 token-serving latency
- active GPU count per pool
- rx_drop / tx_errors

Anya: If rx_drop > 3% for 5m we pause and rollback. Also watch for NVLink errors and scheduler OOMs.

Sam: Playbook excerpt: 
```
# cordon + drain + reboot (example)
rbctl cordon cohort-01
rbctl drain --evict-pods cohort-01 --grace 300
rbctl reboot cohort-01 --type soft
# post-reboot checks
netdiag --multipath-check || alert
nvlink-health --summary | grep ERROR
```

Jamie: Will long-running training jobs be preempted?

Sam: Scheduler will try to live-evacuate. Jobs >2h are at risk of preemption; teams should checkpoint or use Dedicated capacity. We'll skip marking critical tenants for evacuation.

DevEx: I posted rollout note in #announcements and customer-status; flagged 4 tenants for manual skip.

Oncall-Mike: I'll create an ephemeral Grafana dash for cohort metrics and take ownership for the window. I'll also thighly monitor backlog and token-serving p99.

Liam: Any special network routing changes? multipath path reshuffle sounds like we might flip primary NIC routes.

Sam: Yes, we'll rotate primary egress to alternate NICs in a staggered way to avoid incast. Expect temporary flow re-resolve on a subset of nodes; we pre-seed ARP/neigh caches and warm multipath tables.

Anya: If we see >5% connection resets to upstream model shards for >10m, we roll back.

Jamie: Post-window validation?

Sam: Post-window: 2h observation window. Collect kv-cache hit rate, warmup times, p99 latency, and any OOM/reschedule counts. Tag any quality regressions. If stable, unpause non-critical backfills and close the run.

InfraBot: cohort-01 canary started at 2025-09-14T23:06Z. Metrics update scheduled in 10m.

Liam: I'll be on-call for canary checks.

Anya: Watching metrics as well.

Oncall-Mike: Acknowledged. Setting alert thresholds and will page if breach.

Sam: :thumbsup: Thanks team — ping here if you see anything unexpected. If we need immediate rollback call the pager and annotate the action with `rollback: true` in incident log.

Jamie: Confirmed — will hold non-urgent deploys for APAC during 23:00–02:00 UTC.

DevEx: Customer comms sent.

Sam: Final note: owners for each cohort = Liam (cohort-01), Anya (cohort-02), Jamie (cohort-03). Keep messages short and post failures here.
